records.title: Teorema di Bernoulli
records.independentDerivation: Bernoulli: p2=p1+(rho/2)(v1²-v2²); with rho1000kg/m³ gives p2[kPa]=41/2-v2²/2
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Steady incompressible inviscid same streamline, horizontal, no pump/loss; density1000kg/m³ must be assigned in full context. Square velocity, subtract1, halve and subtract from20.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Conditional on assigned water density; kPa conversion is Pa/1000, not multiply1000.

records.title: Pressione statica e dinamica
records.independentDerivation: Pitot stagnation-minus-static pressure=rho*v²/2; with rho1000 gives q[kPa]=v²/2
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Ideal stagnation along streamline, incompressible liquid, correct alignment and equal datum; rho needs full context. Square then divide2.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Stagnation pressure exceeds static; this is not absolute static pressure.

records.title: Stenosi e aneurisma in modello ideale
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Steady incompressible flow and positive area ratio. Divide2 by dimensionless area ratio.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Area ratio is not radius ratio; mechanical physiology in real pulsatile/compliant vessels not implied.

records.title: Condizioni di validità
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Steady horizontal constant-area incompressible flow; no pump/turbine, identical velocity terms. Subtract loss in kPa.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Loss positive reduces pressure; J/m³=Pa.

records.title: Flussi laminari e turbolenti
records.independentDerivation: Re=rho*v*D/eta; D=1/100m eta=1/1000Pa*s => Re=10*rho*v; rho1000 gives10000v
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Newtonian liquid and diameter-based Reynolds definition. Density absent in prompt-only projection:1000kg/m³ conditional. Convert1cm to.01m; dimensions cancel.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Re is a regime indicator; transition threshold is not an exact universal classifier or guaranteed parabola.

records.title: Regime stazionario
records.independentDerivation: Stationary only says partial_t(v)=0; if parabolic profile with vmax8, v(R/2)=8(1-1/4)=6cm/s
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Need supplied parabolic fully-developed circular profile for6; stationary alone does not determine6. Once profile given,8*3/4 by manual multiplication.
records.adversarialInterpretation: A stationary plug profile with axis8 has velocity8 at half-radius: distinguish steady from spatially uniform.

records.title: Viscosità dinamica
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Assigned Newtonian constitutive relation and gradient4s^-1. Multiply viscosity by4; Pa*s times s^-1 is Pa.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Reported positive magnitude differs from vector sign of force on each opposite plate.

records.title: Gradiente di velocità
records.independentDerivation: Linear Couette gradient=delta_u/h=40mm/s divided by h[mm]
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Parallel plates with linear velocity profile; positive gap1..8mm. Common mm factors cancel.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Endpoint difference/gap is mean gradient; without a linear profile not every local gradient is this value.

records.title: Profilo parabolico laminare

records.adversarialInterpretation: Zero at wall; negative speed outside r/R>1 would be outside control domain.

records.adversarialInterpretation: A diameter/radius confusion has same ratio only if changed consistently; laminar regime must remain applicable after radius change.

records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Linear capillary resistance fixed3kPa*s/mL. Multiply flow by3; s and mL cancel.
records.adversarialInterpretation: This is pressure difference, not absolute pressure or power; zero flow needs zero modeled drop.

records.title: Limiti dei modelli fisiologici
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Rigid Poiseuille model, unchanged pressure difference/length/viscosity. Convert percent, then square twice.
records.adversarialInterpretation: +20% radius gives1296/625, not+80%; -20% gives256/625. This ideal sensitivity is not a patient-specific prediction.

records.title: Resistenze idrauliche in serie e in parallelo
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Two linear positive hydraulic resistances in parallel with common endpoints. Multiply2R2 and divide by sum.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Equivalent below each branch; same formula is not a series sum.

records.title: Portata nei rami
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Shared prescribed12kPa node pressure difference; positive linear branch resistance. Divide12 by resistance.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Other branch changes do not change this branch flow if node pressure difference remains externally fixed.

records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Steady positive linear resistances; downstream outlet0kPa, inlet10kPa. Divide total drop by sum then multiply downstreamR.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Node pressure is measured relative to downstream0; upstream drop uses other resistor.

records.title: Tensione superficiale
records.independentDerivation: Two film surfaces F=2gammaL; gamma1/20N/m, L=x/100m => F=x mN
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Soap film has two interfaces and uniform tension, straight mobile boundary; ignore additional support weight in modeled balance. Convertcm tom, NtomN.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Single surface would give half. Count interfaces, not two sides of boundary arbitrarily.

records.title: Piccole quantità di liquido
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Spherical droplets of common positive radius; total area/totalvolume for equal spheres same3/r. Pi cancels, no calculator required.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Doubling radius halves area/volume; planar/merged drops do not satisfy this formula.

records.title: Bagnabilità e capillarità
records.independentDerivation: Jurin h=2gamma*cos(theta)/(rho*g*r); assigned maximum10mm gives h=10cos(theta)mm
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Static capillary model, contact angle through liquid, fixed radius/liquid/gravity. Use exact known cosine for assigned angles.
records.adversarialInterpretation: 90° gives0, obtuse gives depression. Actual selected angle must be checked later for manual feasibility; no approximate cosine demanded here.

records.title: Interfacce piane e curve
records.independentDerivation: Single spherical interface delta_p=2gamma/r=2gamma*k; k[mm^-1]*1000 gives m^-1 => delta_p=100k Pa
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Spherical liquid drop one interface; gamma.05N/m, positive curvature1/r. At0 curvature interpret planar limit.
records.adversarialInterpretation: The defined k is1/r, while mean-sum curvature is2/r; do not remove physical factor2.

records.title: Legge di Laplace e pressione di curvatura
records.independentDerivation: Soap bubble two spherical interfaces delta_p=4gamma/r; gamma.05 gives delta_p=200/r_mm Pa
records.assumptionsAndManualProcedure: Thin soap film with nearly equal inner/outer radii; gamma constant, negligible thickness. Convertmm tom then divide200 by r_mm.
records.adversarialInterpretation: Single droplet would give100/r_mm. Positive radius excludes division byzero.
